SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks

findings.why: The re-audit restores supplier standing only. It gives no part approval. No controlled record in the documents covers Chisone for BR-225 at a receiving plant and customer. The documents also don't say which customer or program BR-225 belongs to. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether a current approval exists for SUP-C, BR-225, the receiving plant and the customer.
